newsitem.title: USA: Raytech stake cut by N.Y. firm.
newsitem.headline: Raytech stake cut by N.Y. firm.

text.p: Albert Fried & Co LLC said on Wednesday it cut its stake in Raytech Corp to 53,600 common shares or 1.66 percent from 5.82 percent held January 8.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the New York-based broker-dealer said its latest transactions include a net 134,500 common shares sold between January 6 and January 20 at prices ranging from $4.375 to $7 per share.
Raytech, based in Shelton, Conn., manufactures and markets specialty engineered products for heat resistant, inertia control applications.
